acceptance_criteria.criterion: MovieEditorViewModel exposes CoverImageViewModel, ThumbnailsViewModel, ThumbnailGeneratorViewModel as child ViewModels.
LoadAsync loads all three sub-ViewModels in parallel.
MovieEditorViewModel.Movie.CurrentFilePath is surfaced to the Properties tab.
dotnet build -c Release reports zero warnings.
When all image services are provided, LoadAsync initialises ThumbnailsVm, CoverImageVm, and GeneratorVm
When any image service is null, sub-VMs remain null — no NullReferenceException
Previous sub-VMs are disposed before being replaced on a subsequent LoadAsync
dotnet build -c Release reports zero warnings

summary: Added 5 optional constructor parameters to MovieEditorViewModel (IThumbnailRepository, ICoverImageService, IThumbnailGenerationService, IThumbnailViewerService, IFfprobeRunner) and stored them in new private readonly fields.
Added 3 [ObservableProperty] declarations for CoverImageVm, ThumbnailsVm, GeneratorVm plus computed string ThumbnailTabHeader (mirrors ThumbnailsVm.TabLabel ?? 'Thumbnails').

Extended LoadAsync with an image-services block: null-guards all 5 required services; calls DisposeImageViewModels() to tear down previous sub-VMs; constructs ThumbnailsViewModel, CoverImageViewModel, ThumbnailGeneratorViewModel; wires CoverImageUpdated and Thumbnails.CollectionChanged event handlers via named instance methods; assigns observable properties; awaits ThumbnailsVm.LoadCommand and CoverImageVm.LoadCommand in parallel via Task.WhenAll.

Added DisposeImageViewModels() helper (unsubscribes event handlers, calls ThumbnailsVm.Dispose(), nulls all three sub-VM properties) plus OnLinkedThumbnailsChanged and OnLinkedCoverImageUpdated named handler methods.

Added IFfprobeRunner? ffprobeRunner = null optional parameter to MoviePropertiesViewModel full constructor; stored in _ffprobeRunner field (wired for future M9 ffprobe-field population); ShowPropertiesCommand now passes ffprobeRunner: _ffprobeRunner.
Added using System.Collections.Specialized to MovieEditorViewModel.cs for NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs.
dotnet build -c Release: 0 warnings, 0 errors. 413/413 tests pass.
Updated docs/agents/project-manifest/api-surface.md and file-tree.md to reflect all new signatures.

comments.note: MovieEditorViewModel does not implement IDisposable, so if the editor is closed without a subsequent LoadAsync, ThumbnailsVm (IDisposable) is never disposed. The same gap exists for TaggerVm. Both follow the established pattern in this codebase; adding IDisposable to MovieEditorViewModel would be a clean follow-up for M10.

MoviePropertiesViewModel stores _ffprobeRunner but does not yet use it — the TODO M9 comments for FileType/Resolution/Duration/Bitrate fields remain. This is intentional deferral per the WP spec, but a follow-up WP should wire the ffprobe calls and replace the '—' stubs.

The WP-028 spec scope stated 'MovieEditorViewModel.cs only', but passing ffprobeRunner: _ffprobeRunner to MoviePropertiesViewModel required a minor scope expansion to add the parameter to MoviePropertiesViewModel.cs. Build correctness (AC6) took precedence; the change is minimal and self-contained.

summary: All 413 unit + app tests pass with no regressions.

Verified all 6 revised WP-028 AC by code inspection of MovieEditorViewModel.cs: (1) all 3 sub-VMs initialised when services present; (2) null guards prevent NRE when any service absent; (3) ThumbnailTabHeader notified via CollectionChanged → OnLinkedThumbnailsChanged → OnPropertyChanged; (4) CoverImageUpdated forwarded to CoverImageVm.OnCoverImageUpdated(); (5) DisposeImageViewModels() correctly unsubscribes both event handlers and disposes ThumbnailsVm before re-creating; (6) build clean.

Legacy 'not met' ledger AC (from superseded plan version) reviewed: AC1 (child VM properties) ✅, AC2 (parallel load of 2 async VMs + synchronous GeneratorVm) ✅, AC3 (ViewZoomedCommand in ThumbnailsViewModel delegates to _viewerService.ShowAsync) ✅, AC5 (_originalMovie.CurrentFilePath passed to MoviePropertiesViewModel) ✅, AC6 (build clean) ✅. AC4 design evolved in earlier WPs — ThumbnailGeneratorViewModel.GenerateCommand calls _generationService.GenerateAsync() inline rather than ShowAsync on a dialog service, consistent with the embedded-tab architecture.

comments.note: No unit tests cover the new image sub-VM initialization paths in MovieEditorViewModel.LoadAsync (WP-028 additions): null-guard branch, DisposeImageViewModels() on second LoadAsync, ThumbnailTabHeader update via CollectionChanged, and CoverImageUpdated forwarding. The WP spec did not require new tests, but these paths represent non-trivial wiring logic. Recommend adding tests in a follow-up task.

The 6 legacy AC in the ledger ('MovieEditorViewModel exposes child VMs', 'LoadAsync loads all three in parallel', etc.) are from a superseded plan version and were not in the WP-028.md spec. They have been evaluated and are either met or reflect a design that correctly evolved across earlier WPs. These should be considered resolved.

summary: Code review PASS with one Fix-Forward applied. WP-028 extends MovieEditorViewModel cleanly: null guards follow the TaggerVm pattern, event subscription order is correct (before property assignment), DisposeImageViewModels correctly unsubscribes both handlers before disposing, and CoverImageUpdated forwarding to CoverImageVm.OnCoverImageUpdated() is properly wired. All 6 WP-028.md ACs and 6 legacy ledger ACs are met. One Fix-Forward applied: added [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(ThumbnailTabHeader))] to the _thumbnailsVm ObservableProperty so ThumbnailTabHeader is also notified when ThumbnailsVm itself is assigned or nulled (not just when the collection changes). Release build: 0 warnings, 0 errors confirmed after fix.

comments.note: Fix-Forward: added [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(ThumbnailTabHeader))] to the _thumbnailsVm [ObservableProperty] in MovieEditorViewModel.cs. Without this attribute, ThumbnailTabHeader was only notified via OnLinkedThumbnailsChanged (CollectionChanged), which is correct for AC3 but missed the case where ThumbnailsVm itself transitions (e.g., to null in DisposeImageViewModels or from null to a new VM). The additional notification is non-behavioral and does not invalidate QA validation.

MovieEditorViewModel does not implement IDisposable, so ThumbnailsVm (IDisposable) is never explicitly disposed if the editor is closed without a subsequent LoadAsync. The same gap exists for TaggerVm (pre-existing debt noted in the implementation pipeline). Adding IDisposable to MovieEditorViewModel would close this gap cleanly in a future WP. Not blocking.

_currentFilePath is stored in the image init block from _originalMovie.CurrentFilePath and passed to ThumbnailGenerationRequest. ShowPropertiesCommand also reads _originalMovie.CurrentFilePath directly (line ~545) rather than using _currentFilePath. Both paths produce the same value (both read from _originalMovie, which is only replaced on SaveAndExit/ApplyChanges), but the dual-path access is a minor consistency gap worth unifying in a cleanup pass.

[documentation-forward] api-surface.md should document the null-guard semantics for MovieEditorViewModel image sub-VMs: CoverImageVm, ThumbnailsVm, and GeneratorVm are null until LoadAsync is called with all five image services injected. Also note that MovieEditorViewModel does not implement IDisposable — callers must call LoadAsync again (which disposes the previous sub-VMs) or accept a disposal gap on editor close. Add this to the api-surface.md entry for MovieEditorViewModel.
